title: OpenCode: The BEST AI Coding Agent Ever! BYE Gemini CLI & ClaudeCode! (Opensource)
summary: Promo-style update tour of OpenCode: mgrep semantic search, desktop app, new TUI, SDK, Zen models.

assertions.quote: Mgrep is going to make open code four times faster while using three times fewer tokens

verdicts.note: Cursor's own A/B results support it, but Claude Code and others do well with agentic grep alone; benefit is real but tool- and codebase-dependent.

assertions.quote: it actually ships with better feature sets than most AI CLIs

verdicts.note: True of features at the time (LSP, agents, plan mode); Codex CLI has since added several, and 'richer' isn't 'better results'.
